title: Entropy bound for an alphabet of at most $2^c$ symbols
statement:
Let $S$ be a finite nonempty set and let $X$ be a random variable on a probability space $\Omega$ (equipped with a measure $\mu$) taking values in $S$. If the number of elements of $S$ is at most $2^c$ for some natural number $c$, then the Shannon entropy of $X$ satisfies
\[
  H[X;\mu] \;\le\; c\,\log 2,
\]
where the logarithm is natural (so the entropy is measured in nats).
hypotheses_covered: $X$ a random variable on $\Omega$ valued in $S$
replaced:
If $\mathrm{card}(S) \le 2^c$ for some $c : \mathbb{N}$, then
\[
  H[X;\mu] \;\le\; c \cdot \log 2.
\]
